title: Selection for faster division
engine: research/experiments/REPLICATORS/genome.GenomeLenia (modified rule of ours: per-pixel genome g on the line 213 #84 -> 213 #83; persisting matter keeps g, new matter inherits the 2-px mass-weighted g)
mutation: every 10 tu, g += 0.03 x smoothed (8 px) unit noise, seed 4
arms: selected: the genome sets the rule
neutral: rule fixed at 0.3, genome only a marker (same noise)
view: colour = genome on coolwarm, brightness = 0.1 + 0.9 x field; bottom: mass-weighted mean genome
caveats: Inheritance blends genomes where cells grow into each other.
